deviations: Candidate pools built with the DORIS recipe: BM25 paragraph+sentence (~80) + 20 dense (bge-small-en-v1.5, outside every zoo) + gold, shuffled.
Binary gold mapped to graded scale: gold = 2, other pooled = 0 (relevant iff >= 1).
Query has no aspect decomposition; sentence-by-sentence mode uses sentence splitting.
Pages lifted to papers: abstract = page-1 transcription; gold page -> its paper.

format_card.query: Complex multi-aspect paragraph (whole string or sentence-by-sentence)
format_card.answer: Graded relevance over the candidate pool; relevant iff score >= 1
